text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Rejoice. I bestow upon you my grace.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
About this latest research paper... it 
does not hold enough value for Us to keep 
in Our possession. We leave its disposal 
to you; handle it as you see fit.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
—I'll finish reading this shortly. Remain 
kneeling there until I do.
